sourceEvidence.claim: The printed intro — experimental study involving humans; compares therapeutic benefits of ≥2 interventions (eg, treatment vs placebo, treatment vs treatment); study quality improves when randomized, controlled, and double-blinded (neither subject nor researcher knows whether the subject is in the treatment or control group); triple-blind = additional blinding of the researchers analyzing the data
sourceEvidence.quote:
Experimental study involving humans. Compares therapeutic benefits of ≥2 interventions (eg,
treatment vs placebo, treatment vs treatment). Study quality improves when clinical trial is
randomized, controlled, and double-blinded (ie, neither subject nor researcher knows whether
the subject is in the treatment or control group). Triple-blind refers to additional blinding of the
researchers analyzing the data.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Crossover clinical trial — a series of ≥2 treatments on a subject; order randomized; washout period between treatments; subjects serve as their own controls
sourceEvidence.quote:
Crossover clinical trial—compares the effect of a series of ≥2 treatments on a subject. Order in
which subjects receive treatments is randomized. Washout period occurs between treatments.
Allows subjects to serve as their own controls.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Intention-to-treat analysis — all subjects analyzed by original, randomly assigned treatment; no one excluded, “once randomized, always analyzed”; attempts to avoid bias from attrition, crossover, and nonrandom noncompliance, but may dilute the true effects of intervention
sourceEvidence.quote:
Intention-to-treat analysis—all subjects are analyzed according to their original, randomly assigned
treatment. No one is excluded, ie, once randomized, always analyzed. Attempts to avoid bias from
attrition, crossover, and nonrandom noncompliance, but may dilute the true effects of intervention.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: As-treated analysis — all subjects analyzed according to the treatment they actually received; ↑ risk of bias (the ↑ extracts at the line end, carried as printed)

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the dropout-still-counted intention-to-treat recognition, the two-regimens-with-drug-free-interval crossover recognition, the microdose-PK/PD phase 0 profile, the post-approval rare-adverse-effect phase 4 profile), 4 traps (double- vs triple-blind party counts, the three analysis populations, phase 2 efficacy vs phase 3 effectiveness, phase 0 vs phase 1), 3 pivots (the design-vs-blinding router, the analysis-population router, the SWIM phase router), and 8 recall cards covering every printed block.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the definitions and the figure; the attack structure, the distractor designs, and the reverse-direction question shapes are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The three-pass reading protocol (PASS 1 the design ladder: assigned-in-humans, randomized/controlled/double-/triple-blinded, crossover with washout; PASS 2 the analysis population: original assignment vs actually received vs completers only; PASS 3 the phase, via First Aid's own SWIM letters) plus the bias-direction synthesis — ITT preserves the randomization into the statistics and dilutes toward the null while as-treated and per-protocol break it chasing the cleaner comparison.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the three vocabularies side by side but never states the reading order, the party-counting rule for blinding, or the direction each analysis pushes the measured effect; the synthesis is KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] and [1] + blocks[3] the steps block + the visual's ladder/fork/rail zones

kypExtensions.summary: The mnemonic layer: First Aid's OWN two hooks carried VERBATIM and ATTRIBUTED — “Can I SWIM?” (the pipeline sentence's own acronym, printed with “I SWIM” in red; S = Safety, W = Work, I = Improvement, M = Market, the source's red caption words) and “once randomized, always analyzed” (printed inside the ITT paragraph) — plus TWO KYP originals, marked: “THREE BLINDS: SUBJECT, SCIENTIST, STATISTICIAN” and “ALL IN · AS GIVEN · AS PLANNED”. No mnemonic prints in the page's margins (VLM-confirmed); the SWIM letter-pinning on the rail is KYP's overlay of the attributed phrase.
kypExtensions.rationale: The two formulas print in the source's own body text (attributed, not counted among KYP's codes); the two ALL-CAPS codes and the pinning overlay are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics + blocks[6] the memory callout + the visual's rail badges

kypExtensions.summary: The intention-to-treat mini-case — a randomized double-blind anticoagulant trial whose nausea-driven noncomplier returns to warfarin yet is counted in her original arm, with the commentator's “understates the benefit” complaint — routing to ITT (the printed dilution trade) against three distractors: as-treated and per-protocol (the two ↑-bias rules that WOULD produce the larger number) and triple-blinding (the blinding layer misread as an analysis-population rule).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the three rules as definitions only; the vignette, the four options, and the design-layer-vs-analysis-layer distinction are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The KYP-context generalizations, every one flagged as such: the bias channels each design rung closes (confounding, placebo effects, observer bias, analytic bias), why ITT estimates real-world effectiveness and why regulators favor it, why washout prevents first-treatment contamination and why self-control halves the needed sample, why rare adverse effects surface only in open-label postmarketing surveillance, the preclinical→market regulatory reading of a package insert's history, and the bridges to the sibling topics (observational designs assign nothing; the trial's 2×2 feeds RR/ARR/NNT; the bias vocabulary of bias-and-study-errors).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source is a definitions-and-figure page; every mechanism, regulatory, and statistical-logic statement beyond the printed words is KYP context, explicitly marked in the note and never presented as printed text.
